issues.problem: lv set to 2-4, but すら is N1/N2 grammar and the hardest element of every sentence; the existing sura-even file uses lv 1 throughout.
issues.action: Set lv to 1 on every line.

issues.jp_before: 気持[きも]ち{が|ga-subject}沈[しず]んでいる{と|to-conditional}、好[す]きな音楽[おんがく]{すら/さえ|sura-even}聞[き]きたくなくなる。
issues.problem: Distractor ほど gives 好きな音楽ほど聞きたくなくなる ('it is favourite music in particular that I don't want to hear'), which is grammatical and close to the English.
issues.action: Replaced distractor ほど with しか.

issues.jp_before: 昔[むかし]{から|kara-from}{の|no-possessive}友達[ともだち]{すら/さえ|sura-even}、彼[かれ]{の|no-possessive}本当[ほんとう]{の|no-possessive}気持[きも]ち{は/が|wa-topic}分[わ]からなかった。
issues.problem: English 'oldest friends' mistranslates 昔からの友達 (longtime friends).
issues.action: English changed to 'Even his longtime friends ...'.

issues.jp_before: 最近[さいきん]{は|wa-topic}、好[す]きなゲーム{すら/さえ|sura-even}やる気[き]{が|ga-subject}出[で]ない。
issues.problem: Nすら + やる気が出ない is loosely formed (ゲームですら / ゲームをする気すら would be needed).
issues.action: Rewrote as 最近は、好きなゲームすら楽しめない。 'Lately I can't even enjoy the games I like.' with a new why.

issues.jp_before: 一人暮[ひとりぐ]らし{の|no-possessive}娘[むすめ]{から|kara-source}、一年[いちねん]{に|ni-frequency}一度[いちど]{すら/さえ|sura-even}連絡[れんらく]{が/は|ga-subject}ない。
issues.problem: 一年に一度すら連絡がない is awkward (natives say 一度も or 年に一度の連絡すら); the English was stilted.
issues.action: Rewrote as 一人暮らしの娘から、年に一度の電話すらない。 'My daughter, who lives on her own, doesn't even call me once a year.' (f=4).

issues.problem: Distractor に in the first やら slot of a noun list gives AにBやら; に is itself a listing particle (AにBに), so the result means the same list and is only mildly marked.
issues.action: Replaced distractor に with へ, which is ungrammatical there. Verb and adjective lists keep に, which is impossible after a predicate.

issues.problem: lv 3-4 is implausible: やら listing is N2 grammar; the existing yara-list file uses lv 1-2.

issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]{は|wa-topic}、食[た]べる{やら|yara-list}飲[の]む{やら|yara-list}{で|de-cause}、冷蔵庫[れいぞうこ]{が|ga-subject}すぐ空[から]になる。
issues.problem: English 'eats and drinks so much, and so on' was garbled; 弟 is really the subject of the やら clause, so が is the natural marker.
issues.action: Slot changed to {が/は|ga-subject}; English changed to 'What with my little brother eating and drinking, the fridge is empty in no time.'

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{が|ga-subject}、嬉[うれ]しい{やら|yara-list}寂[さび]しい{やら|yara-list}{で|de-cause}、娘[むすめ]{の|no-possessive}結婚式[けっこんしき]{で|de-place}泣[な]いていた。
issues.problem: The sentence topic is the mother, so は is the natural marker and が gave no alternative; 'lonely ... and everything' was an unnatural translation of 寂しい here.
issues.action: Slot changed to {は/が|wa-topic}; English changed to 'My mother cried at her daughter's wedding, feeling happy and sad at once.'

issues.jp_before: 親戚[しんせき]{が|ga-subject}来[く]る日[ひ]{は|wa-topic}、掃除[そうじ]{やら/とか|yara-list}料理[りょうり]{やら/とか|yara-list}{で|de-cause}朝[あさ]{から|kara-from}晩[ばん]{まで|made-until}動[うご]き回[まわ]る。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate content: 料理 already appears as a listed item in two other lines of the file (掃除するやら料理をするやら, 飾り付けやら料理やら).
issues.action: Changed 料理 to 買い出し; English and why updated to 'cleaning, food shopping and so on'.
